result.summary: Scope test: REQ-007 has real user-visible/behavioral surface (four locale routes + /health respond over HTTP), so this is not the docs-only skip case. Wrote docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-007.md with one case per each of REQ-007's 5 acceptance criteria in requirements.yaml: AC1 (file-move completeness + real git rename, verified via ls at both locations plus git log --follow showing pre-move history), AC2 (root package.json workspaces/private fields plus npm run build/lint exit codes from repo root), AC3 (post-move npm run build && npm run start serving all 4 locales with matching <html lang> and no next-intl fallback markers, plus /health returning 200), AC4 (apps/web/messages/ key-set diff script extended to all 4 catalogs against the ru.json baseline, with exact expected counts/output verified live against the current working tree: ru/uz/en/kk all 177 keys, zero missing/extra), AC5 (git log --follow apps/web/src/i18n/routing.ts must show the pre-migration commit chain back through REQ-001a/003-004/005-006, not just the move commit). Every case names the exact command(s) and exact expected output/exit code -- no 'looks right' language. Verified independently before writing: the move is already committed on this branch (git status clean, apps/web/* present, root src/messages/public/etc. absent), git log --follow on the routing file already shows 4 commits including the move, and the live key-set diff script run against apps/web/messages/*.json today produced the exact counts embedded in AC4's expected output.
